name: habit creation collects name, schedule, and reminder

payload.text: What would you like to build? Send a short habit name.
When do you want to practise it?
What time should I remind you? Send it as HH:MM, like 07:30.
Your habit “Read” is ready. I’ll remind you at 07:30 in UTC.

name: time zone accepts an IANA zone

payload.text: Set your time zone first. Send an IANA name, like Europe/London or America/New_York.
Your time zone is set. Now let’s create your first habit.
